metadata.summary: PubMedQA is a biomedical QA dataset built from PubMed abstracts. It comprises 1,000 manually annotated (expert) QA pairs (PQA-L), 61.2K artificially generated QA pairs from existing abstract rationales (PQA-A), and 211K unlabeled QA pairs (PQA-U). Each question is answered with Yes / No / Maybe based on a given PubMed abstract, targeting evidence-based biomedical reasoning.
metadata.purpose: To evaluate reading comprehension of scientific literature and support evidence-based biomedical reasoning.

papers.title: PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering

modality.scope: Biomedical research questions and PubMed abstracts

ethics.privacy_measures: No personal health information; derived from publicly available PubMed abstracts.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PubMed's public use terms; no PHI.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Derived from PubMed abstracts (not patient data)
bias_and_limitations.modifications: PQA-A artificially generated from abstract rationales; PQA-U unlabeled.
bias_sources: Sampling bias (abstracts only, no full-text or clinical context)
Labeling bias (small expert set, synthetic expansion)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Abstracts reflect published, English-language, peer-reviewed literature — underrepresents non-English, preprint, or negative-result studies.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Ternary classification; 'Maybe' class may be underrepresented or inconsistently applied.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Results may not generalize to full-text biomedical documents, clinical notes, or non-English literature.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No demographic or geographic subgroup coverage — abstracts lack patient-level attributes.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: PQA-U has no labels; PQA-A labels are synthetic and may lack expert validation.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Questions and answers derived from PubMed abstracts to support evidence-based biomedical reasoning.

population.target_population: Biomedical research questions grounded in English-language PubMed abstracts
population.inclusion_criteria: Questions answerable with Yes/No/Maybe based on a single PubMed abstract.
population.missing_groups: No patient-level or demographic population; not applicable.

annotation.annotation_method: Manually annotated by experts for PQA-L; PQA-A generated from abstract rationales.
annotation.labeling_provenance: PQA-L: expert-annotated; PQA-A: artificially generated from abstract rationales; PQA-U: unlabeled.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Tasks requiring patient-level data, real-world clinical decision support, or fine-grained answer spans.
